note: fn/splitByValue/019 without collapseContexts, so SUPPRESS shows: Tag in context Orders is true, false | true, false, false, one Item per Tag, five. createIf gives "", SUPPRESS, "", SUPPRESS, SUPPRESS, and eachValue puts each slot in a context of its own: [""] [SUPPRESS] [""] [SUPPRESS] [SUPPRESS].
